resources.string: AliLoginCompat
Experimental WUA state rewriting for supported Taobao and Idlefish security libraries. Login recovery is not guaranteed.
AliLoginCompat · Experimental

This experiment replaces seven candidate state bytes before WUA encoding. Their complete meaning is unknown. It does not suppress logout, change device identity, or make invalid server credentials valid.
Idlefish: rewrite candidate state bytes
Taobao: rewrite candidate state bytes
Fold Taobao deny pages into a small bubble
The draggable bubble stays inside Taobao and does not take focus. Close it to keep it hidden across restarts. Turn this option off and on to restore it. Server failures remain failures.
Taobao rejected some requests (419). The error page was folded.
Close and keep bubble hidden
Save one private local WUA diagnostic sample on app startup
Enable this module for Taobao and Idlefish in your framework. Restart the target app after changing settings. Turn rewriting off for observation, or disable the module to remove its hooks.
Diagnostics runs local WUA generation once and, on Taobao, MiniWUA generation twice. It saves samples and short native buffers only to the target app’s private cache. Leave it off for normal use.
Framework preferences are unavailable. Enable the module and reopen this screen before configuring it.
Saved. Restart the target app to apply.
Observe Taobao business security factor generation

Off by default. Saves at most eight existing calls per selected API, including private native buffer prefixes, only in Taobao cache. Does not initiate requests or change results. Captures only the calling thread. Turn off for normal use.
Observe Taobao environment checks (trace_env)
Enable Taobao environment compatibility layer (experimental)
Both environment switches are off by default and independent of candidate-byte rewriting. trace_env only logs accessed properties, paths, interfaces, and syscalls without changing return values.
Observe Taobao request status only

Off by default. Logs only validated API names, HTTP/MTOP status codes, monotonic time, and temporary response numbers. No headers, bodies, credentials, or native hooks. Turn off and restart Taobao after diagnostics.
Report USB as disconnected to Taobao SecurityBodyAdapter
Off by default. Changes only doAdapter(10) from connected to disconnected. Other environment values and native hooks remain unchanged.
